scope: Re-review three expired product-policy boundaries against current source and existing scoped browser evidence; no broader availability or performance certification.

claims.finding: The fence keeps public calculator inputs and results available to guests. Paid plan definitions remain separate. The ten-route cohort verifies concrete guest calculations and usable outputs; this is not exhaustive functional certification or a forever-free promise.

The signup modal calls AfroAuth.signup with email, name, password and country. Signup calls Supabase auth.signUp with tier free and no paid checkout or payment fields. This verifies the product boundary only: no live account was created and provider/email delivery availability was not certified.

The approved wording limits compatibility and low-bandwidth statements to named measurements. Mobile workflow distinguishes heuristic scans and local throttled smoke from carrier measurements. Cohort tests name 320px/390px checks; education tests distinguish offline local saves from reload and cloud limits. No all-device, 2G-speed, universal offline or live cloud claim is approved by this review. The known navigation error remains an open release gate.
